---
title: "Complete case: single-cell"
---

<span class="version-chip">Executed: SCOP 0.8.9 · R 4.5.1 · synthetic input</span>

## Biological rationale

We use a small synthetic count matrix with two declared biological states. The purpose is to demonstrate the workflow seams and the evidence record, not to mimic a patient cohort or establish a biological discovery.

## Input contract

- 120 genes × 80 cells.
- One RNA assay and two declared groups.
- Synthetic counts with state-associated marker signal.
- No patient, clinical, or treatment interpretation.

## Workflow

```r
library(Seurat)
library(scop)

srt <- CreateSeuratObject(counts, project = "scop-learn-single-cell")
srt$group <- group
srt <- RunCellQC(
  srt,
  qc_metrics = c("umi", "gene"),
  UMI_threshold = 0,
  gene_threshold = 0,
  verbose = FALSE
)
srt <- NormalizeData(srt, verbose = FALSE)
srt <- FindVariableFeatures(srt, nfeatures = 60, verbose = FALSE)
srt <- ScaleData(srt, features = VariableFeatures(srt), verbose = FALSE)
srt <- RunPCA(srt, features = VariableFeatures(srt), npcs = 12, verbose = FALSE)
srt <- FindNeighbors(srt, dims = 1:8, verbose = FALSE)
srt <- FindClusters(srt, resolution = 0.4, verbose = FALSE)
srt <- RunUMAP(srt, dims = 1:8, verbose = FALSE)
estimated_dims <- RunDimsEstimate(
  srt,
  reduction = "pca",
  reduction_method = "scree",
  verbose = FALSE
)
```

The complete executed script is [available in the repository](https://github.com/Carl6231/scop-learn/blob/main/scripts/single-cell-case.R). The script writes an evidence record and the figure shown below.

The input and output identities are recorded in the evidence manifest."}

## Expected insights

- The object retains 80 cells and 120 genes after the deliberately permissive QC checkpoint.
- The declared group signal remains visible in the low-dimensional view.
- The SCOP dimension estimator returns a suggested range; it does not replace inspecting the scree behavior or choosing dimensions for the study.
- The evidence manifest records the exact package and runtime identity used to create the plot.

## Interpretation boundary

The two colors are labels deliberately inserted into a synthetic matrix. They are not discovered cell types, treatment effects, or evidence about a patient population. The case demonstrates how to build and inspect a workflow, not how to make a claim from arbitrary clusters.

## Review checklist

- Check the QC thresholds and retained-cell count.
- Check which assay and features feed PCA.
- Check the dimensions used for neighbors and UMAP.
- Record whether cluster identities agree with declared or external evidence.
- Preserve the evidence manifest before changing the workflow.
